description: WAKE COUNTY – Today, Michael Whatley spoke with hard-working North Carolinians at a roundtable in Zebulon focused on the No Tax on Tips provision of the Working Families Tax Cut Act. The hospitality industry personnel and other job creators discussed how the No Tax on Tips has helped working families across the state keep more of what they earn in their family budget instead of sending it to Washington, DC.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley Hosts No Tax on Tips Roundtable in Zebulon – Michael Whatley for Senate
